'''Karl Harford''' (also published as '''Karl Hartford''')<ref name="dt-16237">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16237 WYS Han and Luke running it], DeckTech (Karl "Fal" Harford, 27 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16237/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16237/ GitHub Pages]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027070321/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16237/ Internet Archive]</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Fal''') posted a [[Light]] [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]] list on DeckTech in May 2001. Karl Harford also played at [[2000 North American Continental Championship]] on 11 August 2000 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA beats]], according to Steven Lewis's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1120">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-milwaukee-wisconsin-8-12-00d1120/ milwaukee-wisconsin-8-12-00], DeckTech (Steven "Sir Yoda" Lewis, 14 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-milwaukee-wisconsin-8-12-00d1120/ GitHub Pages]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261025142259/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-milwaukee-wisconsin-8-12-00d1120/ Internet Archive]</ref>
